notes.title: AbrezBeta
notes.content:
Get ready to test your reflexes and precision in Abrez, an explosive arcade game where every shot counts. During this event, dive into fast-paced 3-minute matches where your goal is simple: shoot the right cans, avoid the wrong ones, collect coins, and buy special bullets to dominate the conveyor belt.

Colorful cans, powerful ammo, spectacular combos… but also traps. If too many cans or pyramids reach the end of the belt, the level is over.

Aim carefully, manage your bullet inventory in real time, and adapt to each wave to maximize your performance.

The game supports both keyboard and gamepad controls, with a quick-access help screen (spacebar) showing all essential shortcuts.

An online leaderboard updates in real time with each player's best score, username, and avatar. Challenge your friends and climb to the top of the rankings.
